en.headline: Man dies after falling from building in Sham Shui Po
en.dek: A 55-year-old man was found dead on Tuesday evening after falling from a tenement building near the junction of Nam Cheong Street and Lai Chi Kok Road, striking a parked works vehicle.
body: Police said a 55-year-old man died on Tuesday evening after falling from a building at the junction of Nam Cheong Street and Lai Chi Kok Road in Sham Shui Po.

The man struck the roof of a parked drainage works vehicle before landing on the road. The vehicle driver heard a loud noise and alerted police. Ambulance crews confirmed the man had died at the scene.
Officers sealed the area for investigation. Preliminary inquiries indicated the man may have fallen from a fifth-floor unit. The cause of the fall remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 深水埗男子墮樓壓中工程車後死亡
zh.dek: 一名55歲男子周二晚在南昌街近荔枝角道交界大廈墮下，先壓中停泊路邊的渠務工程車再反彈落地，當場不治。
body: 警方表示，周二傍晚約7時，一名55歲男子在深水埗南昌街近荔枝角道交界大廈高處墮下，先撞到一輛停泊路邊的渠務工程車車頂，再反彈跌落行車線。
工程車司機聽到巨響後報警，救護人員到場證實男子已死亡。警方封閉現場調查。
初步調查顯示事主可能由五樓單位墮下，警方正繼續調查墮樓原因。
